name: Mechanical System Design
description: Design methodology – history, lifecycle, sustainability; planning, development of specifications from requirements, solution finding; systematic design methodology – functional decomposition, morphological methods, TRIZ, axiomatic design; concept evaluation and selection – technology readiness, Pugh’s method, decision risk, robust decision making; engineering concept to embodiment design – rules and principles; product evaluation for performance and effects of variation; guidelines for embodiment design – design for cost DFC, manufacture and assembly DFMA; uncertainties and robustness, sustainability (lifecycle), fail-safe - design for reliability DFR, design for environment DFE, other measures DFX; configuration design – best design practices – interfaces and connections; detailed design – case studies.
